narrative.overview: Paper Theatre turns the homepage into a toy theatre. Red curtains and layered cobalt arches frame a different cut-paper scene for each research case. The title on the apron opens the case. Pulling the tab changes the scenery.
keyCharacteristics: Vũ Chí Thành’s name anchors a narrow cream masthead above the stage.
The programme lists the cases in performance order, with a product, year, title and credit for each.
The results section prints the latest award and researcher credits beside the annual team placements.
dos: Keep the links to the full cases accessible in both the stage captions and the programme.
Preserve researcher credits, team placements and source links as layouts reflow.
Use the deep brick ink for small colored text on cream.
Keep screen navigation and controls outside the printed résumé.
